name: Throwback
source:
When your guardian dies, he leaves you a real castle--but his estranged son arrives to take it away. Hawk Blackmoor could be a fairy tale knight if he weren't your enemy... and a master of BDSM. Can you handle Hawk's dominant side? Or will you surrender to him?

[From in-app]
translation:
当你的监护人去世时，他给你留下了一座真正的城堡——但他疏远的儿子来了，把它拿走了。霍克·布莱克摩尔（Hawk Blackmoor）如果不是你的敌人的话，他可能是一位童话骑士……而且还是一位BDSM大师。你能对付霍克的统治者吗？还是你会屈服于他？

[来自应用程序内]
